commands.name: view-history
commands.title: View Report History
commands.subtitle: Is Agentic

tools.name: get-agent-readiness
tools.title: Get Agent Readiness Report
tools.description: Get the latest completed Is Agentic score, findings, evidence, and recommendations for a public website

tools.name: compare-agent-readiness
tools.title: Compare Agent Readiness
tools.description: Compare latest completed Is Agentic reports for two public websites

ai.instructions: Use Get Agent Readiness Report for questions about one website's agent readiness, score, evidence, or recommendations. Use Compare Agent Readiness only when the user provides two websites or explicitly requests a comparison. Reports are completed snapshots: never imply that a tool starts, refreshes, or waits for a scan. If a report is unavailable, explain that the user must start a scan on is-agentic.com and retry after it completes. Keep recommendations attributed to the report and link the report URL when useful.

evals.input: @is-agentic How ready is https://example.com for AI agents?
@is-agentic Compare the agent readiness of https://example.com and https://example.org.
